content:
I'll bound the copy.
<tool_call>
<function=edit_file>
<parameter=path>
track.c
</parameter>
<parameter=old_text>
    strcpy(t->callsign, callsign);
</parameter>
<parameter=new_text>
    strncpy(t->callsign, callsign, CALLSIGN_LEN - 1);
    t->callsign[CALLSIGN_LEN - 1] = '\0';
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

arguments.summary: Bounded the callsign copy to CALLSIGN_LEN-1 and always NUL-terminate, so long callsigns no longer overwrite the guard field.
